title: egg'o'villager
description: a submission to Smithed 1st April Jam
body:
# egg'o'villager
egg'o'villager is silly and goofy datapack with egg of villagers. This datapack is submission to Smithed 1st April Jam.

# What is adds?
This datapack adds Egg of Villager. To make it, you need to drop emerald and egg to ground. Watch how it hatches! Egg of Villager have custom-made gravity, so you can drop it from 200 blocks nicely!
